headline: Linde Stock Barely Moved While Its Order Book Hit A Record
summary: A record backlog of plants, led by a new electronics win, is the clearest evidence yet of how Linde keeps topping itself up, and of how slowly that shows up in the stock.

headline: Honeywell Technologies Completes Sale of Productivity Solutions and Services Business to Brady Corporation
summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C., August 03, 2026--Honeywell Technologies (NASDAQ: HON) today announced the completion of the sale of its Productivity Solutions and Services (PSS) business to Brady Corporation in an all-cash transaction.
